//: Copy to eidan.deploy.json (gitignored) and edit. Bundles are private sibling repos vendored into the build; targets are where you ship.

bundles.name: sage
bundles.//: or fetch from git instead of a local path:

pi-node.//: ssh-node: a host running the engine as a node process under systemd (no Docker). rsyncs the runtime + restarts the service; keeps the host's own matbot.yaml + .env unless you pass --sync-config.
pi-node.//disable: optional: plugin dir names to strip for THIS node's role (e.g. a backend-only node: ["sage","frontend-telegram"]). Used by `check` and `deploy --sync-config`.
pi-node.//env_keys: optional: env key NAMES this node must have, for `check` env drift (names only, never values).
pi-node.//env_files: optional: paths `check` reads (deploy user must be able to read them) to see which keys are set.
